integrity: Symbolic equivariant chain decomposition with self-contained finite modular consistency tests; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite, complete transitively oriented layered digraphs, complex coefficient field at primitive N-th root, unreduced nonregular Mayer path homology only.
Universal matrices give exact algorithms for all N and r; elementary closed Betti formulas are supplied for r=N=3 only.
Mayer path homology may not be a homotopy invariant of the underlying undirected graph.
No claim of exhaustive worldwide novelty or external independent certification.
title: Augmentation-block characters of Mayer path homology on layered digraphs
